name: dmtool
description: Author, validate, and safely edit A12 Kernel document models — validation rules, computed fields, and model structure (fields, groups, type-defs, includes) — with the dmtool CLI. Bundles the native binary (downloaded on demand by the skill, the first time the agent needs it) + the authoring skill. Targets A12 Kernel 31.1.1 (A12 Tools 2026.06-ext1).
